key_insight: H²R uses hierarchical mathematical hints as intermediate milestones in reinforcement learning to improve multi-step reasoning.
engineering_relevance: Structured sub-question checkpoints offer a way to guide verifiable-reward training beyond final-answer correctness.
method: Represent mathematical problems through hierarchically structured sub-questions.
Use hierarchical hints as intermediate conditioning signals during reinforcement learning.
Evaluate reasoning with the HiMath benchmark.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports Qwen2.5-Math-7B accuracy on HiMath improving from 30.4% to 39.1% with hierarchical hints and reaching 45.6% with Oracle Hierarchical Hints.
watch_item: Practical gains may depend on hint reliability and availability; oracle hints may not reflect deployment conditions.
paper_title: H$^2$R: Hierarchical Hint-Based Reward for Mathematical Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
